newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end at new high, Endesa, Repsol soar.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end at new high, Endesa, Repsol soar.

text.p: Madrid stocks closed at new highs on Thursday, beating key general index resistance at 400 boosted by hefty gains in Endesa and Repsol, dealers said.
The general index up 4.35 points, 1.10 percent, to 400.31 and the Ibex added 50.18 points, 1.1 percent, to 4,616.72.
Electricity firm Endesa added 210 pesetas to 8,490 after ratings agency S&P's confirmed its long-term debt ratings and said the stock had been taken off CreditWatch.
Dealers also cited switching into Endesa from Fecsa, which added 15 pesetas to 1,055 and Sevillana, which also rose 15 pesetas to 1,230.
An offer by Endesa for the remaining 75 percent of Sevillana and Fecsa finished earlier this week.
Energy group Repsol was also strong, adding 85 pesetas to 4,700 resistance, still catching up after underperforming for most of the year, dealers said.
The government plans to sell stakes in both Endesa and Repsol next year.
